A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''nobleman''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Irmenu]], and the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of a [[Unidentified Irmenu princess|daughter]] who held the title of [[Prince/Legends|princess]]. When the nobleman's daughter fell in love with [[Walon Vau]], the son of an Irmenu [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] and [[Count/Legends|count]], both the nobleman and Vau's [[Walon Vau's father|father]] refused to consent to the match. The two lovers attempted to defy their parents' will, but their rebellion ended with the nobleman's daughter in an [[Imperius]] [[Monastery/Legends|convent]] and the young Walon Vau's [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] from Irmenu.<ref name="ZotR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Irmenu nobleman was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the fifth installment of [[Jason Fry]]'s official [[Star Wars Blog]] series, [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''The Essential Guide to Warfare: Author's Cut'']].
